title: Quantum space-time at the Planck scale is a quantum computer

statements.text: Space-time at the Planck scale is discrete, quantized in Planck units and qubitized, its pixels a quantum memory register processed by a network of unitary quantum logic gates that is part of space-time itself, so quantum space-time is a quantum computer.

sources.quote: We assume that space-time at the Planck scale is discrete, quantised in Planck units and "qubitsed" (each pixel of Planck area encodes one qubit), that is, quantum spacetime can be viewed as a quantum computer
